question: When should the deities of the six rites be worshipped during ritual practice?
premises: Deities of the six rites are declared.
The rite has a beginning phase.
Those deities should be worshipped then.
inference: The deities of the six rites should be worshipped at the beginning of the rite.
plain_english: The deities of the six rites are declared; one should worship them at the beginning of the rite.
